$comment: Repo-committed Claude Code config. Per docs/rstr-agent-plan.md §7a, the agent lives in the REPO,
not in a personal ~/.claude — the point is that it is the same agent for everyone, including a
future hire. Personal overrides belong in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).
Hooks here solve the compaction problem (§7b): compaction replaces real history with a lossy
summary and nothing forces a re-ground afterwards. PreCompact drops a marker; SessionStart
(compact) or the next UserPromptSubmit consumes it exactly once and re-injects the state file.
